topic: Identification of types of paint & Restoration of paint i.e. nitro cellulose lacquer epoxy, fluorescent and enamel surface protection.
syllabus_extract: Identification of types of paint & Restoration of paint i.e. nitro cellulose lacquer epoxy, fluorescent and enamel surface protection.
specific_objectives: 6.2.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand surface protection materials, paint identification, restoration of various paint and application, dope shop, dope articles and troubles.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Identification of paint samples; Safety precautions: Ventilation, PPE; Instructor supervision: Direct observation
intro_questions: What is the primary function of surface protection on aircraft?
Name two common environmental factors that damage aircraft paint.
Why is paint identification critical before restoration work?

development.content:
Surface protection materials overview
Nitro cellulose lacquer characteristics
Epoxy paint properties

Fluorescent paint identification
Enamel surface protection types
Restoration techniques overview

Dope shop functions and articles
Common paint troubles and causes
Troubleshooting restoration issues

summary_questions: Differentiate between nitro cellulose lacquer and enamel paint applications.
Identify the main cause of paint peeling during restoration.
List two safety precautions required in a dope shop.
home_assignment_question: Research the preparation methods for paints and list the equipment used for application as covered in LP 12.

pft_rows.syllabus: Methods of applying surface protection, preparation of paints, equipment used, common paint and troubles.
